semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company specializes in ultrasonic cleaning equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Zhangjiagang Ultrasonic Electric Co., Ltd. manufactures ultrasonic automatic cleaning equipment that is utilized for cleaning silicon materials, wafers, and sapphire pieces in the semiconductor industry. Their products are also applicable in various other industries, including aerospace and electronics.
capabilities: Ultrasonic cleaning systems for silicon wafers
Automatic cleaning equipment for sapphire pieces
Cleaning solutions for mechanical parts in electronics

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Zhangjiagang, Jiangsu Province, and has been recognized as a high-tech enterprise in the region.
